question: Madhavacharya (12th century) wrote Madhava Nidana which contains ______ chapters exclusively on diagnosis of the diseases (nidana).
solution:
The correct answer is __**69**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Madhava Nidana,** written by **Madhavacharya in the 12th century, **has** 69 chapters** that are dedicated solely to sickness diagnosis **(Nidana).**
 
• It is the first work of its kind in Ayurveda to concentrate solely on one subject, diagnosis.
 
• It is interesting to observe that not a single sutra makes any reference to how to treat an illness.
 
• For the first time, comprehensive descriptions of** Amavata (Rheumatism) **and **Amlapitta (Acid-peptic diseases) **are provided.
 
• **The details of Vatavyadhi (Neurological disorders) are pretty detailed. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Madhvacharya, also known as** Purna Prajna and Nanda Tirtha,** was a **prominent advocate of the Dvaita (dualism) school of Vedanta and an Indian philosopher and theologian.**
 
• Madhva's philosophy was known as Tattvavda, which translates as **"Arguments from a realist viewpoint."**
